descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: This API has a limit of 10 queries per second (QPS) for each user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. This can affect your business. Call the API at a reasonable rate.
